daily.today_energy: Mercury's got you feeling chatty and curious—lean into those random conversations today. Something someone says might spark an idea you've been needing. Trust the synchronicity.
daily.love: If you're coupled up, your person is picking up on your vibe shift. Single? Someone's definitely noticing you're glowing rn. Keep it real though—authenticity hits different.
daily.career: Your creative energy is peaked right now. This is the day to pitch that idea you've been sitting on or tackle that project differently. Your instincts are sharp.
daily.health: Your body's asking for movement and fresh air—even a short walk counts. Your nervous system feels lighter when you're not stuck in one spot. Hydrate and flow.

weekly.overview: This week's energy is all about authenticity, Sag. Venus is whispering you deserve better boundaries and Mercury's vibes suggest clarity is coming. Trust the little nudges pointing you toward what actually matters.
weekly.love: If you're coupled up, this is peak time for real talk that feels good. Single? Someone's noticing your glow. Either way, stop dimming yourself down—your weird is exactly what someone needs right now.
weekly.career: Projects you've been sitting on are ready to move. Your natural confidence is magnetic this week, so lean into collaboration over solo grinding. The universe is basically handing you permission to level up.
weekly.health: Your body's asking for presence, not perfection. Whether that's stretching, dancing, or just sleeping without your phone—listen to what actually feels nourishing instead of what sounds productive.
